notes.title: Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hi, Devs Here

We’re thrilled to share that we’ve just hit 1,000 wishlists—thank you all for your incredible support! 🎉 To celebrate this milestone, we’re planning to release our first demo in September 2025. This will be an early build that we’ll continue improving over time: we’ll be adding new mechanics, polishing features, and fixing any bugs you uncover.  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3219820/Road_Motel_Simulator/  Stay connected with us by adding Road Motel Simulator to your Wishlist and following our Steam page—you won’t want to miss the latest news!

And if you’d like a direct line to the team, hop into our Discord server—share your thoughts, ask questions, and get sneak peeks straight from the devs.

See you in the motel!

notes.title: Store Page Update
notes.content:
Hello, Devs Here

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3219820/Road_Motel_Simulator/

While we’re putting the final touches on the demo, we invite you to add Road Motel Simulator to your Wishlist and Follow us so you won’t miss any of our updates!
